repos.name: NVIDIA/Model-Optimizer
repos.description: A unified library of SOTA model optimization techniques like quantization, distillation, pruning, neural architecture search, speculative decoding, etc. It compresses deep learning models for downstream deployment frameworks like TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT, vLLM, etc. to optimize inference speed.
repos.one_liner: A unified library providing state-of-the-art model optimization techniques for deep learning deployment.
bullets: Built on Python with deep integration into NVIDIA's hardware acceleration stack.
Implements advanced techniques including quantization, pruning, distillation, and speculative decoding.
Essential for quant and fintech firms deploying high-frequency inference models on edge or cloud hardware.
Reduces model latency and memory footprint while maintaining high precision for production environments.

repos.name: strands-agents/harness-sdk
repos.description: Build an agent harness and control it end-to-end. Open-source SDK for production AI agents in Python & TypeScript - any model, any cloud.
repos.one_liner: An open-source SDK for building, controlling, and managing production-grade AI agents.
bullets: Multi-language support (Python and TypeScript) for flexible agent orchestration.
Provides a standardized harness to control agent workflows across any cloud or model provider.
Designed for enterprise-grade reliability, observability, and end-to-end agent lifecycle management.
Ideal for building autonomous financial research agents or complex defi transaction automation.

repos.name: lemony-ai/cascadeflow
repos.description: Cascading runtime for AI agents. Optimize cost, latency, quality, and policy decisions inside the agent loop.
repos.one_liner: A cascading runtime engine designed to optimize AI agent performance, cost, and policy compliance.
bullets: Python-based runtime that intercepts and optimizes the agent execution loop.
Dynamically manages trade-offs between latency, inference cost, and output quality.
Enforces strict policy decisions within the agentic workflow to ensure governance.
Highly applicable for fintech applications where cost-per-query and regulatory compliance are critical.

repos.name: trailofbits/coop
repos.description: Isolated VM environment for running Claude Code and Codex
repos.one_liner: An isolated virtual machine environment specifically designed for running AI coding agents like Claude Code.
bullets: Written in Rust to ensure high-performance, secure sandboxing for untrusted AI-generated code.
Provides a hardened environment to prevent AI agents from accessing sensitive host system resources.
Critical infrastructure for developers integrating AI agents into secure software development lifecycles.
Mitigates security risks associated with autonomous agents executing arbitrary shell commands.

repos.name: eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter
repos.description: 354 条循证建议，覆盖长寿防病、急救、省钱理财、法律红线、失业与工伤、医保社保、恋爱婚育、出国与技能。每条写明成本、收益、证据等级和原始出处，只引期刊论文与官方文件。
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive, evidence-based repository covering financial planning, legal rights, and life management.
bullets: Structured as a curated knowledge base of 354 actionable, peer-reviewed life and financial recommendations.
Focuses on high-utility topics including social insurance, labor law, and personal finance optimization.
Each entry is backed by academic journals or official government documentation for high reliability.
Serves as a practical reference tool for professionals managing personal risk and long-term financial health.
